title.narrative: Building Flood Resilience in Schools along the Niger River in the Ségou Region

description.narrative: This project seeks to safeguard the right to quality and inclusive education for children in flood-prone areas along the Niger River in Mali. With a budget of USD 33,333, it will provide essential learning materials to 400 vulnerable students and train 25 teachers in mental health and psychosocial support to address the needs of learners and educators affected by crises. Through strategic partnerships, the initiative strengthens Mali’s education resilience and aligns with global frameworks such as the SDGs and the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction. By ensuring continuity of learning and promoting well-being, the project contributes to national priorities under PRODEC II and supports commitments to integrate psychosocial support into education policies and practices.
